baseline.note: byte-identical to releases/v3, submitted ref 56636116, public LB 0.06

rev2_changes: write_file allowed only after the complete untruncated file is read and all unaffected content can be preserved; otherwise route to the scripted edit
scripted edit must assert the anchor occurs exactly once BEFORE writing, then read git diff and run py_compile, with git checkout -- named as the undo
step 1 must confirm anchor uniqueness with git grep -c -F first
removed any implication that fewer required arguments serialise better

host_wheel_vs_upstream.note: differs by 405 bytes; whether the parser file differs is NOT established

rev3_changes: item 1: removed the git grep -c -F first-line uniqueness count; the scripted check is now assert old and s.count(old) == 1 over the whole block, and the contradictory line-count instruction is gone
item 2: a unique /tmp backup is taken before a recovery write and restored on a wrong attempt, instead of git checkout -- which would discard earlier valid edits to the same file
item 2: read_bytes/write_bytes preserve encoding and line endings
item 2: the diff is reviewed in bounded sections until empty instead of head -40
item 2: py_compile is applied only to .py files

reviewer.pin_update_rule: arming flips DISPATCH_CONFIRM and changes the notebook bytes; update the pin deliberately and record both values
false_positives_fixed_2026_09_30: recovery: a successful read_file after a rejection counted as recovery if the path appeared in the patch. Read-only tools now never qualify; an explicitly successful MODIFYING operation is required, its target must match a changed source path EXACTLY after normalisation, and the tool's own change evidence (edit_file diff, or write_file filepath+size) must tie it to the patch. Without that: 'consistent with recovery; attribution unproven'.

patch validity: absent agent_patch_size was tolerated and a diff header alone passed as a source patch. The recorded size must exist, be an int, and equal the preserved text; header-only, malformed-hunk and count-mismatched patches are rejected; syntactic validity, application evidence and actual source change are now three separate properties.
other_corrections: provenance: BOTH agent and grading phases must carry a successful observation before the graded path is called verified
identity: duplicate control arms, off-plan runs and a mismatched manifest run order now ABORT rather than warn
a missing submission is reported as grading UNOBSERVED, kept separate from a demonstrated instrument fault
a refusal from the notebook's own REPORT cell is recorded as an artifact finding instead of crashing the reviewer
the synthetic SOURCE_PATCH fixture had inconsistent hunk counts and is now a valid patch
